verdict.rationale: Drata documents automated monitoring tests against connected systems: a Monitoring Tests API with list, update and exclusion endpoints, a 'Understanding Monitoring in Drata' guide, Connections, and agent-based device configuration checks. A community member confirms that non-compliant personnel and devices surface in the Drata dashboard. missing for 10: documented test cadence showing failures surface within hours, alerting/notification on failing controls, and in-depth docs beyond page titles or hands-on corroboration of timing.
